description: M3 golden set (ADR 0009): 8 cases for each of the 17 scenarios of the five reason categories, keeping every case of unauthorised-v1, and 12 adversarial variants of each kind (injection, overclaim), whose correct decision is their scenario's.

cases.rationale: Meets the unauthorised-transaction criteria but exceeds the provisional credit limit; a human decides.
